# Intel Xeon Phi-only families (ledger U990-U995) WITHOUT their UC_CTL_X86_AVX512 bits: every
# form #UD with the rest of AVX-512 enabled. Generated by ref_xeonphi.py --offcases; run:
#   emu-alltest --cases Emulator\data\cases_xeonphi_off.txt --avx512 --expect-only
# VP4DPWSSD without AVX512_4VNNIW
.byte 0x62, 0xf2, 0x5f, 0x48, 0x52, 0x06 |  => #UD
# VP4DPWSSDS without AVX512_4VNNIW
.byte 0x62, 0xf2, 0x5f, 0x48, 0x53, 0x06 |  => #UD
# PREFETCHWT1 (0F 0D /2) is a NOP hint with or without CPUID.(7,0):ECX[0]
# PREFETCHWT1 byte ptr [rsi]
.byte 0x0f, 0x0d, 0x16 |  =>
